lines.text: Never open the door after 3 A.M.
We moved to Bloxbury on a Tuesday.
By Wednesday, I knew something was wrong.
Mum said she'd be home late.
The girl next door, Rae, didn't even say hello.
I thought she was joking. She wasn't.
That afternoon, everyone boarded up their windows.
And the Mayor's house had no door.
